name: code-search
description: Search GitHub for code, repositories, and commits through the GitHub search API. A GitHub personal access token is optional but required for code search and to raise rate limits; repository and commit search work anonymously.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Search code, repositories, and commits on GitHub

fields.label: Personal Access Token
fields.helpText: GitHub PAT — required for code search and private repos; also raises search rate limits.

tools.name: code.search_code
tools.description: Search source code across GitHub repositories. Requires a GitHub token.

query.description: Code search query, e.g. 'addClass in:file language:js repo:jquery/jquery'

tools.name: code.search_repositories
tools.description: Search for repositories on GitHub by keyword and qualifiers.

query.description: Repository search query, e.g. 'machine learning language:python stars:>1000'

tools.name: code.search_commits
tools.description: Search commits across GitHub repositories by message and qualifiers.

query.description: Commit search query, e.g. 'fix memory leak repo:torvalds/linux'
